description: This source file contains platform-specific functions and scripts for firmware upgrade routines, including checks, procedures for different hardware models, and upgrade processes.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Performs validation checks on the firmware image to ensure compatibility with certain boards, particularly ASUS and ZTE models; suggests partition deletion if necessary.

methods.name: askey_do_upgrade
methods.description: Executes firmware upgrade procedure for specific hardware by extracting and writing the root filesystem partition.

methods.name: zyxel_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade specific to Zyxel devices by handling kernel and root partitions from the firmware archive.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_mikrotik_nand
methods.description: Handles upgrade process for Mikrotik devices with NAND storage, formatting and writing the kernel partition.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main dispatcher function to perform firmware upgrade tailored to specific device models, calling appropriate functions based on device type.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies device configuration in specific cases (e.g., certain Gl.iNet and Google WiFi devices).
